newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.35 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.35 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.35 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.

This compares with six-month HIBOR of 5.95313 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 5.39 percent at the pervious tender on September 10. Bids for the HK$800 million issue was HK$2.61 billion against HK$5.12 billion.
The average accepted yield of 91-day bills was 5.20 percent, against three-month HIBOR of 5.68750 percent and the average accepted yield of 5.12 percent at last week's tender.
Bids for the HK$1.50 billion issue eased to HK$4.41 billion from HK$6.42 billion.
